page.overview:
Who is Richard Kiley?

Richard Kiley was the primary automated narrator voice heard on the CD ROMs in the tour cars, he was the tour guide for the park, identifying to passengers the animal they were seeing as well as information about it. The staff at Jurassic Park "spared no expense" in hiring him.
